The **Clinical Outcome** of patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] in [[Danmark]] is a critical focus of national healthcare monitoring, aiming to minimize severe complications and optimize treatment adherence. The primary adverse events tracked are [[Iskæmisk apopleksi]] and [[Intrakraniel blødning]], both of which are heavily influenced by the proper administration of [[antikoagulationsbehandling]].

Between July 1, 2021, and June 30, 2022, the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients in Denmark who developed an ischemic stroke within one year was 1.1% [^src1]. During the same period, the incidence of intracranial bleeding within one year was 0.7% [^src1]. More recent data from the [[Atrieflimren i Danmark]] registry for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, indicates that these clinical outcomes remained stable, with Indicator 14 reporting a 1.3% incidence of ischemic stroke (95% CI: 1.1–1.4) and Indicator 13 showing a 0.8% incidence of intracranial bleeding (95% CI: 0.7–0.9) among newly diagnosed patients [^src4].

A critical component of preventing these adverse clinical outcomes is the consistent use of anticoagulation therapy. For the period from July 1, 2018, to June 30, 2019, the national proportion of atrial fibrillation patients receiving anticoagulation treatment was 87.3% (95% CI: 86.5–88.1) [^src2]. There was notable regional variation in treatment adherence across different health clusters. For instance, [[region-nordjylland]] achieved a high treatment rate of 91.1% (95% CI: 88.7–93.0), with specific clusters like [[Klynge NORD]] reaching 94.1% (95% CI: 90.3–96.7) and [[Klynge SYD]] at 94.3% (95% CI: 88.5–97.7) [^src2]. In contrast, [[Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] reported a lower rate of 80.0% (95% CI: 67.7–89.2), and [[Klynge VEST]] was at 83.1% (95% CI: 73.3–90.5) [^src2]. Long-term adherence is also monitored; nationally, 89.1% of atrial fibrillation patients were on anticoagulation treatment one year after diagnosis, 88.6% after two years, and 87.3% after five years, as tracked by [[Indikator 4a3]] [^src3].

Beyond pharmacological interventions, [[Patientuddannelse]] has been shown to positively impact clinical outcomes. A meta-analysis by [[Palm et al., 2020]], which included five randomized and one non-randomized intervention study totaling 2,007 patients, demonstrated that patient education reduced the combined risk of death and readmission by 22% (Risk Ratio 0.78, 95% CI 0.63-0.97) compared to groups receiving no patient education [^src5].

## Claims

- Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som udvikler iskæmisk apopleksi inden for 1 år, var 1,1 % i Danmark i perioden 01.07.2021–30.06.2022 [^src1] (atrieflimren, iskaemisk-apopleksi, danmark)
- Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som får intrakraniel blødning inden for 1 år, var 0,7 % i Danmark i perioden 01.07.2021–30.06.2022 [^src1] (atrieflimren, intrakraniel-bloedning, danmark)
- I perioden 01.07.2018–30.06.2019 var den nationale andel af patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog antikoagulationsbehandling, 87,3 % (95 % CI: 86,5–88,1) [^src1] (danmark, atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)
- I perioden 01.07.2018–30.06.2019 var andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog antikoagulationsbehandling, i Nordjylland 91,1 % (95 % CI: 88,7–93,0) [^src1] (region-nordjylland, atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)
- I perioden 01.07.2018–30.06.2019 var andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog antikoagulationsbehandling, i Sundhedsklynge Bornholm 80,0 % (95 % CI: 67,7–89,2) [^src1] (sundhedsklynge-bornholm, atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)
- I perioden 01.07.2018–30.06.2019 var andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog antikoagulationsbehandling, i Klynge NORD 94,1 % (95 % CI: 90,3–96,7) [^src1] (klynge-nord, atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)
- I perioden 01.07.2018–30.06.2019 var andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog antikoagulationsbehandling, i Klynge SYD 94,3 % (95 % CI: 88,5–97,7) [^src1] (klynge-syd, atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)
- I perioden 01.07.2018–30.06.2019 var andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog antikoagulationsbehandling, i Klynge VEST 83,1 % (95 % CI: 73,3–90,5) [^src1] (klynge-vest, atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)
- På landsplan var 89,1% af patienterne med atrieflimren i AK-behandling 1 år efter diagnosen blev stillet, 88,6% efter 2 år og 87,3% efter 5 år [^src1] (indikator-4a3)
- Indikator 14: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede atrieflimren-patienter, der udvikler iskæmisk apopleksi inden for 1 år, var 1,3 % i Danmark for perioden 01.07.2022–30.06.2023 (95 % CI: 1,1–1,4) [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, iskaemisk-apopleksi)
- Indikator 13: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede atrieflimren-patienter, der får intrakraniel blødning inden for 1 år, var 0,8 % i Danmark for perioden 01.07.2022–30.06.2023 (95 % CI: 0,7–0,9) [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, intrakraniel-bloedning)
- Meta-analysen indeholdt fem randomiseret interventions studier og et ikke-randomiseret interventionsstudie med i alt 2007 patienter og viste, til fordel for interventionsgruppen der modtog patientundervisning, en reduktion på død og genindlæggelse på 22% (Risk Ratio 0.78, CI 95% 0.63-0.97) i forhold til gruppen der ingen patientundervisning havde fået (Palm et al., 2020) [^src1] (palm-et-al-2020, patientuddannelse)
